responsibility: Declares the dump_context abstraction that centralizes GCC’s dump_* API behavior, especially the conversion of dump calls into pending optinfo records and their emission to dump files, -fopt-info output, and JSON optimization-record writers. It defines scope management, location-aware dumping of gimple/tree/symtab entities, filtering by dump flags and priorities, the dump_pretty_printer that captures formatted chunks as optinfo_items rather than plain text, and RAII helpers for temporary debug/selftest contexts.
